detail: The owner identifies the gallery at 703 Queen Street, opened in 1959.
The 2017 architects describe a stone volume wrapping the east wing, transparent lower programs, and two large viewing apertures facing the green and the Saint John River.
The 2022 architects describe a 835 square metre entry hall, gently concave light precast colonnade with radiating fins, full-height glazing, broad stairs and an accessible ramp.
The precast fabricator describes a lightly blasted finish, structural column and fascia details, and 51 individual entrance step pieces.
